section_heading: SECTION 5 PORT SERVICE LICENCE, PORT RULE LICENCE, PORT RULE REGISTRATION AND PORT RULE PERMIT FEES
plain_summary: This page details various fees payable for port service licenses, port rule licenses, port rule registrations, and port rule permits issued by the Authority. It lists specific fees for services like floating crane, stevedore, waste disposal, bunkering, diving, fire protection, pest control, and pollution control licenses. It also includes fees for vessel agent registration, motor vehicle access permits, and permit replacements, while noting several access permits and small/pleasure vessel permits are free.

ambiguities_or_risks: The specific 'duration of licence' or 'duration of registration' is not defined on this page, only that fees are payable 'on an annual basis, over the period of the licence'.
